search_text: published ZDI-07-060 ZDI-CAN-134 Hewlett-Packard OpenView Radia Integration Server File System Exposure Vulnerability 2007-10-31 CVE-2007-5413 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-5413 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['OpenView Radia Integration Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to access arbitrary files on systems with vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard OpenView Radia Integration Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HTTP server bound by default to TCP port 3465. Insufficient checks on URLs containing paths such as '~root' allows attackers to access arbitrary files in the underlying OS. Accessing configuration files that contain LDAP and database credentials can lead to further compromise. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
